name: Desert Medical Equipment
old_description: Your Nationwide Mobility Partner: 22 Years Serving Travelers & Industry Leaders.
about:
Desert Medical Equipment was founded in 2003 by Bryan Schultz and is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. Schultz, who previously pioneered the concept of placing medical equipment on-site at hotels and convention centers, started the company to address the growing needs of travelers with disabilities. The business remains privately held and has expanded to operate across 13 states.

The company provides mobility scooter and medical device rentals, including FAA-approved portable oxygen concentrators, to disabled travelers. Its service model covers equipment reservations, delivery and pickup, cleaning, maintenance, and 24/7 customer support. Desert Medical manages a rental fleet that serves hospitality and entertainment venues nationwide, with on-demand delivery that ensures equipment is waiting at the guest’s destination.

Primary customers are hotels, resorts, convention centers, and entertainment complexes in the hospitality and entertainment sectors. These partners rely on Desert Medical to handle mobility logistics for their guests with disabilities. The company also serves individual travelers who rent equipment directly for temporary use during their stay.

Schultz founded the company on a personal commitment to helping people with disabilities, a mission that drives its differentiation. Desert Medical emphasizes customer service leadership, offering emergency 24-hour device service and a seamless rental experience. It is one of only three providers in the United States that rent FAA-approved portable oxygen concentrators, a niche that underscores its specialized focus.
